# HubbardDensity

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/HubbardModels` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/HubbardModels/HubbardDensity`

Manual: [HubbardDensity (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/HubbardDensity.md)

```text
HubbardDensity, version 0.01

Usage: HubbardDensity [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --left-state : name of the file corresponding to the state |Psi_L> (the order parameter being <Psi_L|c^+c|Psi_R>
    --right-state : name of the file corresponding to the state |Psi_R> (the order parameter being <Psi_L|c^+c|Psi_R>
    --show-time : show time required for each operation
    --degenerate-leftstates : single column file describing a set of degenerate left states
    --degenerate-rightstates : single column file describing a set of degenerate right states

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with ent extension

tools options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
